entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, agent ID 401. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and order number, please?
Mark Peterson. Order is VF8675309.
Thank you, Mark. I have your order right here. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the tracker? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Neither. I just don't want it anymore.
Okay. Looking at the delivery date, I see it was received 19 days ago. For our VeloBand trackers, we have a strict 10-day return policy due to hygiene protocols and device activation.
Of course you do. Just my luck.

I understand the policy can be frustrating. The 10-day window is firm, but we can make exceptions for significant life events. Was there any particular emergency, like a sudden trip to the hospital or an unexpected military deployment, that prevented you from contacting us sooner?
As a matter of fact, yes. My wife was in the hospital. We had bigger things to worry about than your return window.
I am so sorry to hear that. I truly hope she is recovering well. Was it an unexpected surgery or a sudden event?
Yes, it was an emergency. We've basically been living at the hospital since it was delivered. She's fine now, but it was a whole ordeal.

Thank you for sharing that, Mark. That absolutely qualifies as an exception. I've noted the medical emergency in your file and I am authorized to override the policy for you as a one-time courtesy. I can process a full refund for you.
Fine. So what do I do now?

I've just approved the return in our system. I am emailing you a pre-paid shipping label as we speak. Please place the VeloBand back in its original packaging, attach the label, and you can drop it off with any mail carrier. Once our warehouse receives it, your full refund will be issued.
Whatever. Thanks, I guess.
You are very welcome. I'm glad I could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No.
Alright. Thank you again for calling VeloFit, and please send our best wishes to your wife for a speedy recovery. Have a good rest of your day.
